name: Pupil Dynamics Analysis
description: Analyzes pupil dilation patterns, reflexes, and synchronization to detect AI-generated faces.
useCase: Detecting deepfakes through unnatural pupil behavior and missing light reflexes
mechanism: Tracks pupil size changes, pupillary light reflex, and consensual response across video frames. Real pupils dynamically respond to light changes and cognitive load. AI-generated eyes often have static pupils, irregular shapes, or missing pupillary reflexes.
source: Guo, Y. et al. (2022) - Exposing Deepfake Face Forgeries with Guided Residuals, IEEE TMM
algorithm: Iris/Pupil Segmentation + Dilation Tracking + Light Response Correlation
parameters: Pupil detection: circular Hough transform, Tracking: Kalman filter, Light analysis: brightness correlation
strengths:
• Pupil behavior is very hard for AI to simulate
• Real-time physiological signal
• Works across different face types
• Highly specific to video forgery
limitations:
• Requires high-resolution eye region
• Dark iris colors reduce accuracy
• Colored contacts interfere
• Camera distance limits applicability

references.title: Guo, Y. et al. (2022). Exposing Deepfake Face Forgeries with Guided Residuals. IEEE TMM.
Hu, S. et al. (2021). Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights. ICASSP.
Jung, T. et al. (2020). DeepVision: Deepfakes Detection Using Human Eye Blinking Pattern. IEEE Access.
